title: WarpToad fee-cap concrete execution fixtures

artifact_route.circuit: the D1P-12R committed beta.22 withdraw artifact, whose source correspondence was established by D1P-13
artifact_route.verifier: the D1P-12R generated Solidity verifier, byte-identical to the pinned committed verifier
artifact_route.consumer: the pinned unmodified L1WarpToad mint implementation
artifact_route.network: owned in-process Hardhat EDR chain, no fork and no live-chain access

fc_neg.proof: reuse the FC-POS proof and identical mint calldata
fc_neg.ordering: submit the reverting FC-NEG transaction before FC-POS so the positive mint remains in final local state; both use the same already-generated FC-POS proof and calldata

proof_attempts.attempt_1_reason: Generate the new FC-POS honest proof with max_fee below amount and a nonzero in-cap fee.
proof_attempts.attempt_2_reason: A distinct proof is required for the supported zero-fee control because fee_factor is proof-bound.

claim_boundary: Concrete owned-local development evidence only. This is not a performance result, vulnerability claim, protocol-policy validation, cross-chain reachability result, or D1 security verdict.
